simple.meaning: קָדִים (qâdîym) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward , for brevity the east wind ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 41:6. The surrounding context includes land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָדִים (H6921) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward , for brevity the east wind )
definitions.full: H6921. qadim קָדִים 69 noun masculine Hosea 13:15 East, east wind ; — absolute ׳ק Gen 41:6 +; with ה locative קָדִ֫ימָה Ezek 11:1 +, קָדִ֫מָה 48:4 +; — 1 (apart from Ezekiel) East , especially (הַ)קּ ׳רוּחַ wind of the East, east wind , often as violent and scorching, from desert on southeast, = Arabic sirocco ( eastern ), compare Dr Amos 4:9 : Exod 10:13 (twice in verse) (JE), 14:21 (J), Jer 18:17 (simile), Jonah 4:8 ; Psa 48:8 ; also ׳ק ( רוּחַ omitted) = east wind Gen 41:6 , 23 , 27 (E), Hosea 12:2 ; 13:15 ; Isa 27:8 ; Job 15:2 ; 27:21 ; 38:24 ; Psa 78:26 . — קָדִימָה Hab 1:9 is dubious, usually eastward , i.e. forward , but text probably corrupt, compare We Now Da, GASm proposes מַקְדִּים (see also [ מְגַמָּה ] p. 169 above). 2 in Ezekiel (52 t.): a. East הַקּ ׳רוּחַ east wind Ezek 17:10 ; 19:12 ; 27:26 ; east side 42:16 (+ north, south, west); הַקּ ׳שַׁעַר 40:44 (+ north, south); ק ׳מְּאַת 47:18 , + west 48:6-7 , 8 , compare 48:1 ( הַיָּם ׳פ ׳ק ; but read ᵐ5 ׳מִמּ ׳ק פ ׳יְעַד יָמָּה Co Toy and others), + north, south, west, 48:16 ; קּ הַ ׳דֶּרֶךְ i.e. toward the east 40:10 7 t., ׳מִדּ ׳הַקּ 43:2 ; ׳לַקּ 40:23 eastward (+ North) 41:14 ; ׳מֵהַקּ 42:9 on the East. b. קָדִ֫ימָה = East: הַקּ ׳דֶּרֶךְ Ezek 40:6 ; קָדִימָה גְּבוּל 45:7 ; 48:21 (+ west); קָדִימָה מְּאַת 47:18 , + west 48:3 8 t., + north, south, west, 48:32 . c. as adverb קָדִ֫ימָה eastward Ezek 11:1 ; 44:1 ; 47:1 ; + west 45:7 (strike out Berthol Krae), 48:18 , + north, south, west, 48:10 ; 48:17 ; also (הַ)קָּדִים eastward 40:19 ; 43:17 ; 46:1 , 12 ; 47:1 , 3 , + north 47:2 .
